Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-03
DOC-0020 2026-06-20
SHIFT NOTES — Avionics and Controls Desk Split for
Saturday
Date: 2026-06-20
Station: DEMO-STATION-03
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
10:20 — Saturday arrangement from PERSON-0016 for TEAM-0004:
this desk holds avionics intake conversations until 14:20. The
relief-desk role receives controls questions during the same
interval. The split is for queue coordination; it does not
assign physical work or change task ownership.
11:00 — Place ISSUE-0070 and TASK-0182 on the avionics desk
index for DEMO-AIR-0008. Put the subsystem heading above the
reference line. A caller should be able to identify the
correct desk without describing the entire contents of a
folder.
12:15 — Send mixed-subject requests to the station coordinator
for a primary desk choice. Retain the secondary question on
the same dated sheet and identify which role will answer it.
Passing a folder back and forth without a primary contact only
hides the scheduling decision.
14:00 — Brief the relief coordinator before the avionics
interval ends. Show the desk index, the promised contact
times, and any mixed-subject request awaiting a destination.
Keep the original intake question visible during that
conversation.
Next-shift list
— Confirm the next avionics coverage interval at the station
roster.
~- Keep controls requests with the relief-desk role unless the
coordinator records a different destination.
D. Worker 0016
Demo Worker 0016, Demo Team 04
